Course description

A placement lesson for the major, completed October 5, 2026. It showed that you know the broad shape of Indian history but not many specific events or dates. So the major starts with IH100, a quick pass through the whole story, before the detailed era courses.

Learning objectives

  1. Show what you already know about each era of Indian history.
